preconditions.description: The number of movements n is an integer between 1 and 2*10^9 inclusive.
The final position x is an integer 0, 1, or 2.

postconditions.description: The output is the string representation of the initial position of the ball.
The initial position, when subjected to n moves according to the rules (swap 0-1 on odd moves, swap 1-2 on even moves), results in the final position x.
